claims.snippet: Dissolve ingredients (except cysteine and sulfide), adjust pH to 7.0, bring medium to the boil, then cool to room temperature under 100% N2 gas. Dispense under same gas atmosphere into anoxic Hungate-type tubes or serum vials and autoclave. After sterilization add cysteine and sulfide from sterile anoxic stock solutions prepared under 100% N2 gas.
claims.explanation: Manual source review withheld support: The source adds cysteine and sulfide after sterilization from separate anoxic stocks of unspecified strength and volume, and resazurin is supplied as a 0.1% w/v stock. The local flat record has no corresponding stock boundaries and retains an incompatible aerobic import annotation. Reconcile preparation stages and final-volume basis before endorsing the formulation; do not infer stock strengths or doses.

withholdings.snippet: Adjust pH to 7.0. Add catalase and MgSO4 to 10 ml of distilled water each, and sterilize separately by filtration. Cool down autoclaved main solution to 50°C, and aseptically add catalase and MgSO4 solution.
withholdings.reason: Catalase and MgSO4 are separately filter-sterilized. The API assigns 10 ml water to each stock and 980 ml to the base; the original PDF gives 1000 ml water without stock volumes. The local flat record omits those preparation boundaries. Preserve the source-version and stock/final-volume questions rather than endorsing unqualified main-medium concentrations.

withholdings.snippet: Dissolve ingredients (except cysteine and sulfide), adjust pH to 7.0, bring medium to the boil, then cool to room temperature under 100% N2 gas. Dispense under same gas atmosphere into anoxic Hungate-type tubes or serum vials and autoclave. After sterilization add cysteine and sulfide from sterile anoxic stock solutions prepared under 100% N2 gas.
withholdings.reason: The source adds cysteine and sulfide after sterilization from separate anoxic stocks of unspecified strength and volume, and resazurin is supplied as a 0.1% w/v stock. The local flat record has no corresponding stock boundaries and retains an incompatible aerobic import annotation. Reconcile preparation stages and final-volume basis before endorsing the formulation; do not infer stock strengths or doses.
